name: AWI Explosion 07/28/95

date.source: Subject line dates the card “07/28/95”; posted to the newsgroup 1 Aug 1995 (msg_id O8SOMv2GYgEJ).

matches.note: Grace's Explosion debut; won with the Coup de Grace flying elbow. Mathers managed by Johnny “L.A.” Gere (not separately minted).
The Hangman won with a top-rope chokeslam he calls the Noose. Managed by Colt McGraw (not separately minted).
Ki Lung won with a German suplex. Managed by Master Ito Hamakushi (not separately minted).
Talsay won with a sleeperhold (“the Bad Dream”). Managed by RavenMoon (not separately minted).

Taboo pinned Hyde with the Taboosault. Immediately after the bell, Kerry Masters ran in and delivered the “Awesome Ending” to the fallen Hyde, then called out War Machine on the microphone; War Machine answered and chokeslammed Masters -- a post-match angle, not part of the match itself. Taboo managed by Matt D. Tall; Hyde managed by The Plague Dog (neither separately minted).

Main event; White retained via the Gold Medal Hold submission after a mysterious ringside stranger (accompanied by Colt McGraw, the Hangman, and others) distracted Perkins. Perkins managed by Master Ito Hamakushi (not separately minted).

notes: The broadcast opens on a video package crowning Megaton (Heavy Duty and Mass Master, managed by Vinnie “the Mouth”) the new AWI World Tag Team Champions off a win at the AWI Union supercard, shown here only in recap -- Union itself is not a document this collection holds. Commentary team: Heather Rasputin, Michael Helics and Johnny Rooks; ring announcer Alan Kinsman (none separately minted). A backstage vignette introduces Jilliam Bole and Kim “Tiger” Lee (“Perfection”) unveiling a new manager and calling out Concrete Jungle and Steel City Warrior for future matches -- not otherwise structured.

name: AWI Mission Control

date.source: Posted to the newsgroup 13 Aug 1995, subject “[AWI] Mission Control” (msg_id y5sA4-Lv9WwJ).

matches.note: Replay footage billed on-air as being from “last week's Explosion,” taped in Dallas -- a separate, uncollected Explosion episode from the held record's 28 July 1995 script. Trapp won with the Swiss Spike (a tilt-a-whirl piledriver).
Declared a time-limit draw with both men down after Terry Jones' full nelson suplex on Jumbo Titan. Giant Titan and Jumbo Titan (the Super Titans) managed by Matt D. Tall.

notes: A video segment shows Megaton (Heavy Duty and Mass Master) on a comic “world tour” of disaster sites while on hiatus from defending the AWI World Tag Team Championship, with an archeologist at Pompeii congratulating them on “your victory at AWI UNION.” A courtroom-style interview segment (“Miranda Wright's Courtroom,” not separately minted) recaps the Union supercard in detail: War Machine defeating Jack Fury for the AWI North American Championship on 18 July 1995 (Jack Fury previously held the UWA version of the title, per this segment, tying into this wing's own AWE/UWA founding-merger narrative), and questions Jack Fury's manager RavenMoon about the loss; RavenMoon states her stable also includes Talsay and Shadow. D.A. Bookthrower, the reigning AWI World Champion (nicknamed the “Legal Eagle”), is shown only via a framed ringside portrait during this segment and does not himself appear on screen. Commentary team: Trinity Saunders, Paul Stone (announce desk) and Chad Duncan (interviewer, not separately minted). A pre-taped vignette teases a cage match between Crystal Crow and the Mist Angel, arising from a Union-supercard finish recapped but not shown; not otherwise structured.
